item.title: On My Whistle Podcast | TXHSFB Playoffs State Semifinal Preview
item.description: VYPE’s Matt Malatesta, Jackson DiPasquale, Matthew Ogle and Alex Hinson are back to review and preview the Houston high school football scene as we roll into the State Semifinal week of the TXHSFB playoffs, and the storylines are already heating up.The season is coming to an end with the State Championships next week — listen in as Malatesta, DiPasquale, Ogle and Hinson break it all down on On My Whistle.

item.title: THE TREND: State of Washington sanctions girls 7-on-7 football; Eastside Catholic on cusp
item.description: The state of Washington — with major support from the Seattle Seahawks — has officially sanctioned girls 7-on-7 football as a varsity sport. VYPE’s Matt Malatesta caught up with Eastside Catholic’s Paul Morrisroe to discuss how the sport has taken off across the country, what Washington’s landmark decision means for the future, and why his Crusaders are poised to make history. item.title: Lake Creek's Fowles has bounced back after adversity
item.description: Lake Creek’s Raegan Fowles is averaging over 17 points per game, serving as the heartbeat of the Lions’ backcourt. Her journey is one defined by resilience — battling back from a difficult knee injury and returning stronger than ever.The standout underclassman is poised to be the future of Lake Creek basketball, and her impact is already being felt.Check out her story.
